text: Joy and Jorge are celebrating their tenth anniversary on June 3rd. They're doing a weekend in Lisbon, flying out Friday at 6am.
Phoebe got engaged on Saturday night! Her fiancé Malik proposed on the beach at Whitstable. Must send her a card before the weekend.

Marisol's new puppy arrives tomorrow morning. A cockapoo called Biscuit, apparently. She's been puppy-proofing the house for weeks, bought a crate, a playpen and far too many toys. Her husband Jorge is less keen and keeps saying it was her idea, so I suspect he'll be the one doing the 6am walks by Christmas.
Rachel said her cat Pepper has stopped eating again. Vet appointment is Thursday at 4:15. She sounded really worn out.
Need to call Michael before his wedding on May 14 to check he's sorted the rings. He forgot the suits last time.
Juan mentioned his parents' fortieth anniversary is 8/22. He and his sister Kavya are planning a surprise lunch, and he asked if I'd help with the slideshow.
Lunch with Aurelio today. His daughter starts nursery on the 12th at half 9 and he's dreading the drop-off more than she is.
Milan and Astrid have called off the engagement. He seemed okay about it, honestly. They're still sharing the flat until March.
Nikolai is vegetarian now, so no steak place for his birthday dinner.
Pick up dog food and the flea treatment on the way home.
Luca's dog Ziggy turns one on Sunday. Neha is throwing him a little party in the park at 2pm, complete with a dog-friendly cake. Ridiculous, but I'm going.

Xavier told me his brother Antoine is getting married in Marseille on September 9th. He's the best man and is terrified of the speech. I should offer to read a draft. Their mum has been planning it for two years and keeps sending everyone spreadsheets. Xavier flies out on September 6th at 8am and is staying for a week after to help them move into their new place.
Aisha's grandad passed away last week. Funeral is Tuesday at 11 in Bradford. Don't forget to send flowers to her mum's address.
Kiara has been fostering two kittens since August. She's thinking of keeping the ginger one.

Björn and Nora's wedding is on July 19th at 1pm. The reception is at the old mill. Remember to book the hotel before prices go up. Nora said the ceremony is outdoors if the weather holds, so bring a jacket. Björn's mother is coming over from Oslo and doesn't speak much English, and Nora asked if I'd sit with her during the meal.
Lin said Joe has finally asked her to move in with him. They're viewing a flat on Saturday morning.
Ahmed mentioned Jasmine's thirtieth is coming up on October 30. He's stuck for ideas; she's been hinting about a pottery class.
Quick note: Demi's rabbit Clover needs surgery on Wednesday. She's beside herself. Text her Wednesday evening to see how it went.
Abdi and Mariam celebrated their first anniversary yesterday. They went back to the restaurant where they had their first date.

Alfie passed his driving test this morning, on the third attempt! His mum cried, apparently. He's been driving his grandad's old Fiesta around the car park for months, and now it's officially his. He wants to drive up to see his girlfriend Kiara in Leeds on the 24th.
Chioma Usman from the book club is expecting her second baby in early February. She's due on 2/7 but says the first one was two weeks late.
Ring Uncle Jorge on Sunday afternoon. It's his and Auntie Marisol's silver anniversary next week and I haven't got a card yet.
Phoebe's mum is having her hip operation on November 4th. Phoebe is taking the week off to look after her and sounded quite stressed about it.
Rachel Haddad prefers to be called Rae. Works in marketing at the council, lives in Clapham with her partner and two greyhounds.

Dinner with Michael and his fiancée Kavya. The wedding has moved from May 14 to June 21 because the venue double-booked. They're both fuming. Kavya's sister Neha is maid of honour and is already planning the hen do for April. Michael's mum is upset because the new date clashes with her cousin's sixtieth.

Juan's dog Tango was hit by a car on Monday. He's okay but has a broken leg and is in a cast for six weeks. Juan feels awful because he let him off the lead. I should check in with him at the weekend.
Grooming appointment for Bruno moved to Friday at 10:30.
Aurelio and his wife renewed their vows in Italy over the summer. He showed me about four hundred photos.
Milan is allergic to cats, so the party at Astrid's is out for him.
Kavya's engagement party is Saturday at 7. Her parents are flying in from Delhi on Thursday night and staying until the 28th. She asked me to pick them up from Heathrow, which I'm doing.
Nikolai Popescu got the promotion! Head of design from January. Must send congratulations tonight.
Astrid said her old cat Mittens was put to sleep on Tuesday. She had him for eighteen years. Drop round with something on Friday after work.
Malik loves anything to do with vintage watches. He mentioned a Seiko he's had his eye on for ages. Good to know for his birthday on December 2nd.
Luca asked whether I can dog-sit Ziggy from August 3 to August 10 while he and Neha are in Croatia. Said yes. Need to check what food Ziggy eats and when his walks are.
Neha's sister Joy is getting married next spring, and Neha has been asked to do the flowers. She's never done anything like that and is quietly panicking.
Xavier's anniversary is on the 14th, and he completely forgot last year. Remind him on the 13th at lunchtime.
Bought a birthday card for Mum. Still need wrapping paper.
Caught up with Aisha. She's started volunteering at the dog shelter on Saturdays and wants to adopt a greyhound eventually.
Antoine and Kiara are hosting an engagement brunch on March 15 at 11am. Everyone is meant to bring a dish. I'm making the frittata.
Björn said his daughter Lin has her violin grade exam on Thursday at 3:40. She's been practising every night and is very nervous. Send her a good luck message on Wednesday evening.
Nora's dad is turning seventy on 11/18. The family is doing a meal at the Italian place, and she wants everyone to chip in for a new set of golf clubs.

Joe told me his parakeet escaped yesterday afternoon and hasn't come back. He's put posters up around the estate. Ask him tomorrow if there's any news. His son Alfie is devastated because it was his bird really, a present for his eighth birthday in April. Joe's wife thinks it flew towards the allotments, so they're going to look again on Saturday morning.
Ahmed and Jasmine went to the Lake District for their anniversary weekend. Apparently it rained the whole time.
Demi's brother Alfie is proposing to his girlfriend on New Year's Eve. He's asked Demi to film it from behind a tree. Very sweet.
Mariam is going to Abdi's cousin's wedding in Lagos on December 20th and flying back on the 3rd of January. She's nervous about meeting his whole family at once.

Chioma said her husband was made redundant on Friday. She's trying to stay positive but money is clearly a worry, with the baby coming in February. I need to ring her early next week, maybe Monday evening.
Vet for the cat, Monday at 9am. Booster jabs and a weight check.
Phoebe's fiancé Malik wants a small wedding, but her mum wants two hundred guests. Phoebe is stuck in the middle and quite upset about it.
Kiara's guinea pigs are called Salt and Pepper. She's very attached, and she says Salt is the boss.
Marisol says Biscuit has already chewed through two phone chargers and a skirting board. She's booked him into puppy classes starting September 12 at 6:30pm.
Rachel texted this morning: Pepper's blood tests came back clear. Huge relief. She thinks it was just a bad stomach bug after all.

Michael's best man pulled out because of a work trip. He's asked his brother Juan to step in, and Juan has about five weeks to prepare. Juan is not a public speaker. I should send him a few speech templates this week. The wedding is still June 21 at 2pm. Michael has offered to pay for a speech coach, but Juan says that would make him even more nervous. Their dad did the speech at Michael's engagement party and it was mortifying, so the bar is low.
Lunch on Wednesday at 12:30 with Aurelio and Milan. I'm booking the table.
Kavya mentioned her parents met at a wedding in Jaipur. She'd love to find a framed print of the city for their anniversary in May.
Astrid's new partner is called Joe. He's a vet nurse and has three rescue dogs. She seems really happy.
Need to book the dog walker for the week of June 9th and cancel the milk.

Long chat with Nikolai on the phone tonight. His wife Nora is pregnant, due on April 2nd, and they're telling her parents at Sunday lunch. He's also just adopted a beagle called Pickle, which may have been bad timing. Their landlord isn't thrilled about the dog either. He said Nora's been feeling sick most mornings, so she's working from home on Mondays and Fridays. Don't forget to send a little something for Nora once they've announced.
Abdi asked me to be a witness at his and Mariam's registry office ceremony. It's on May 9 at 10am, small and quick, then lunch.

Luca's interview on Monday went well, he thinks. They said he'd hear back by next Friday afternoon. Message him then, and if it's a yes, take him out for a drink. He's wanted to leave the bank for about three years and his girlfriend Aisha says he's been unbearable waiting for news.
Remind me to ask Jasmine how the wedding dress fitting went last Saturday. She was worried it wouldn't be ready in time.
